howto.what: Claude 会指导如何从事件流构建投影和读模型,包括投影架构、投影类型(实时、追赶、持久等)、幂等性、检查点与事务等最佳实践,并可按需提供具体模板。
howto.when: 当用户要求实现 CQRS 读模型、从事件构建物化视图或优化事件溯源系统查询性能时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个基于 CQRS 的订单读模型
say.note: Claude 会给出投影架构和读模型设计步骤

say.text: 从事件流构建物化视图该怎么做?
say.note: Claude 会说明投影类型选择和实现要点

say.text: 投影重放时如何保证幂等?
say.note: Claude 会给出幂等、检查点等最佳实践

howto.what_en: Claude guides building projections and read models from event streams, covering architecture, projection types (live, catchup, persistent), and best practices like idempotency, checkpoints and transactions, with templates on request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to implement CQRS read sides, build materialized views from events, or optimize query performance in event-sourced systems.

say_en.text: Design a CQRS read model for orders
say_en.note: Claude will outline projection architecture and read model design

say_en.text: How do I build a materialized view from events?
say_en.note: Claude will explain projection type selection and key points

say_en.text: How do I guarantee idempotency when replaying projections?
say_en.note: Claude will give best practices like idempotency and checkpoints
